newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT expands Euro 1 overnight service.
newsitem.headline: TNT expands Euro 1 overnight service.

text.p: TNT Worldwide Express said it has extended its Euro 1 express service to 500 cities within Europe.
The overnight service guarantees 09.00 delivery for documents throughout Europe and for freight consignments up to 210 kg throughout the EU, a company statement said.

The Euro 1 service will be further expanded and is also available for shipments from North America, the Middle East and eastern Europe to EU destinations, it added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
